errors.text_span: The outer ring, labeled “Ambiguity Std (Outer)”, is divided into four segments...The inner ring, labeled “Max Ambiguity (Inner)”, is divided into three segments
errors.evidence: The chart is a single donut chart with seven segments, not two separate rings with four and three segments. The 'outer' and 'inner' labels refer to the color-coding of the outer and inner parts of each of the seven segments.

errors.text_span: representing standard deviations of 0.0 (darkest blue, 49.0%), 0.47 (medium-dark blue, 47.7%), 0.82 (medium blue, 5.0%)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns single percentage values to the standard deviation categories. For example, the 'Std: 0.0' category (darkest blue) corresponds to two segments, one with 49.0% and another with 38.0%. Similarly, 'Std: 0.47' corresponds to 47.7% and 39.0%, and 'Std: 0.82' corresponds to 5.0% and 14.2%. The description arbitrarily assigns only one of the values to each category.

errors.text_span: representing maximum ambiguity values of 1 (lightest blue, 38.0%), 2 (medium-light blue, 39.0%)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps percentages to the 'Max Ambiguity' categories. For example, 'Max: 1' corresponds to four segments (47.7%, 7.0%, 5.0%, and 39.0%), not the 38.0% segment. 'Max: 2' corresponds to two segments (49.0% and 38.0%), not the 39.0% segment.
